signals.pageTitle: Abbotswood Junior School - Personal Development Curriculum

signals.text: At Abbotswood, we follow the Language Angels programme of study to ensure we offer a relevant, broad, vibrant and ambitious French language curriculum that will inspire and excite our pupils.
Our English curriculum weaves reading, grammar and writing together, through a rich integrated learning journey that provides a purpose, context and audience for learning.

Net/Wall- Tennis and Net/Wall Skills (LKS2) Strike/Field- Cricket, Rounders, Strike Field Skills (LKS2) Athletic- Indoor and Outdoor Athletics Click to view the PE Medium Term Progression Overview Subject Curriculum Overviews

areas.narrativeSummary: Abbotswood publishes subject curriculum overviews, including for mathematics [1]. English is taught through an integrated approach that weaves reading, grammar and writing together, with purpose, context and audience for learning [4]. French follows the Language Angels programme, described as broad and ambitious [3], and PE includes net/wall tennis, strike/field cricket, rounders, and indoor and outdoor athletics [5]. The school also sets out a Personal Development Curriculum [2].
